title: Difference-in-Differences Models in the Presence of Time-Varying Mediators
abstract: arXiv:2608.18375v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study difference-in-differences (DiD) designs in which a binary treatment changes an endogenous time-varying (continuous, discrete, or mixed) mediator that in turn affects an outcome. Under our model assumptions, we show that the usual DiD estimand mixes the average direct effect on the treated, the average indirect effect, and a trend bias term. A two-way fixed effects (TWFE) regression that controls for the mediator does not recover the average direct treatment effect on the treated. We show that a DiD estimand conditional on the observed mediator path identifies the conditional average direct effect for treated units at that path, and that averaging over the treated path distribution identifies the average direct effect even when unconditional parallel trends fails. translated_title: 存在时变中介变量时的差分中差分模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18375v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们研究了差分中差分（DiD）设计，其中二元治疗改变了一个内生的时变（连续、离散或混合）中介变量，该中介变量又影响结果。在我们的模型假设下，我们表明通常的DiD估计量混合了处理组的平均直接效应、平均间接效应和趋势偏差项。控制中介变量的双向固定效应（TWFE）回归无法恢复处理组的平均直接治疗效应。我们表明，基于观察到的中介变量路径的条件DiD估计量识别了该路径下处理单元的条件平均直接效应，并且即使无条件平行趋势失败，对处理路径分布进行平均也能识别平均直接效应。稳定的平均中介效应假设有助于恢复平均中介效应和间接效应。该框架扩展到多变量中介变量、非线性DiD及更多情况。
tldr: 本文揭示了在存在时变中介变量时，标准DiD估计量会混淆直接、间接效应和趋势偏差，并提出条件路径方法可在平行趋势失效时仍识别平均直接效应。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that standard DiD estimands mix direct, indirect effects, and trend bias with time-varying mediators, and proposes a path-conditional approach to identify average direct effects even when parallel trends fail.
